crossRefs.note: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called…
Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
